text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
Welcome all to the First Fantasy Kinen.
I'm
Mystic Granny, and I'll be
your
commentator for today.

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but suddenly I am filled with a sense
of foreboding. Come,
Umamusume.
Altogether now...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? What's goin' on? Grass! My startin'
gate won't open!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Is this... an arcane lock spell? Is that
allowed?!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I'll just cast Unlock. Now go! Hurry, El!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, you're a lifesaver! Okay. Imma get
you, Uma Lord!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Welp, guess I'll just summon my Uma
Minions! Go get 'em, guys!

text_block_list.name: Uma Minions
text_block_list.text: Uma! Uma Uma!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Yikes, that's no bueno! I'm completely
surrounded, but I'll try and
break through
with my Condor fighting techniques!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah! Hiyooooh! Wataaaah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Pant... Pant... I'm runnin' outta steam!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Greater Heal!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for the backup, Grass! I'm startin'
to get the hang of this
pattern!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Fiddlesticks! Useless cronies!
Guess this is
a job only a lord can finish!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah! Eat this! Earthquake!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: I won't let you do that! Portal Shift!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ohh, you saved me! Let's finish this, once
and for all!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
You won't get away with this!
The real race
starts now!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Picklestones! Descend from the vast
cosmos! Meteor Strike!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Not on my watch! I'll shield us—Holy
Barrier!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Crafty,
aren't we? I'll have to kick it up a
notch, then! Meteor Storm!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Gaaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Where am I now? Did I get
one-shotted? That suuucks...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
You can't die,
El! This isn't the time to be
messing around in
Umadegard!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Full Revival!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: I'm ready for more!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
What? You're back from the dead? Seems
like I'd better prioritize
taking out Grass
first.

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah! Dark Celestial Orb!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaah!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Graaaaass!

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El... don't look back! Umamusume run for
something... more precious
than a friend's
life, right?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
So go on without me. I may not be able to
heal you anymore, but I
can give you... my
hope.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: GRASS!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha! While you're busy with that pity
party of yours, I'll be on my
way!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Noooo! Stop right there!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
What?! How are you accelerating so fast? I
thought you'd used up all
your skills!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I don't need any fantasy skills! This is a
race, the place where an
Umamusume's
true magic shines!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
What matters most is power and
endurance!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text: Whoooaaa! Impossible!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
No obstacle can hold us back! Carryin' the
hopes of our fallen friends, us Umamusume
will put our lives on the line!
All for one
thing...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And one thing alone! VICTORY!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Mystic Granny
text_block_list.text:
And she's crossed the finish line!
El Condor
Pasa takes the win! I can
see it crystal
clear, even with my poor eyesight!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Pretty sure your eyesight has been fine
this
entire time!

text_block_list.name: Uma Lord Golshi
text_block_list.text:
Darn it! I lost...
But I live to fight another
day! Just you wait and see!
